items.title: Blood test may help sepsis patients come off antibiotics sooner
items.summary: A daily blood test could help critically ill patients with sepsis to come off antibiotics sooner, a new study suggests. The ADAPT-Sepsis study examined how clinicians responded to automated advice generated from daily blood tests designed to guide decisions on when antibiotic treatment could safely end.

items.title: BCT Services golf day raises £29,117 for the UK Sepsis Trust
items.summary: The UK Sepsis Trust is delighted to celebrate an incredible fundraising achievement by BCT Services, whose recent golf day raised over £29,000 to help us continue raising awareness of sepsis and support those who are affected by the condition.
